title: Weibull Reliability Analysis Program — Overview and definition
t: Weibull Reliability Analysis Program — Overview and definition
description: Fits Weibull distributions to life data and predicts reliability metrics.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Fits Weibull distributions to life data and predicts reliability metrics. A Weibull analysis program fits 2- and 3-parameter Weibull distributions to complete and censored life data, estimates B-lives, and compares competing designs. Real implementations include ReliaSoft Weibull++, Minitab, and Python reliability. It selects between Weibull, lognormal, and exponential via goodness-of-fit and handles mixed failure modes.
capabilities: Weibull/lognormal/exponential fitting with MLE and rank regression
